title: Pinned Veraphify adoption verification
summary: Lydite main runs a public Ubuntu adoption check that builds a Graphify map, verifies a Veraphify archive and checks a source citation against the separately pinned Lydite v0.0.4 source. This integration landed on main after the published Lydite tag.
acceptance_criteria: Build and verify the archive using independently pinned Lydite, Veraphify and Graphify producer revisions.
Verify the archive digest and the inventory source citation, and retain a run-attempt receipt.

evidence.claim: The main push verified the archive and tools/inventory.py:212 against the Lydite release SHA.
